name: Get RankBloom
author: Lumora Build

sections.description:
RankBloom generates SEO blog content for the sites you connect to it. This plugin brings that
content into your WordPress site — title, body, excerpt, categories, tags, meta description,
schema markup, featured image, and the audio version when you have narration enabled.

The plugin checks RankBloom on a schedule and imports whatever is waiting. Nothing needs to
reach your server from the outside: every request is made outbound by your site. That means
it works behind firewalls, on managed hosts, and on setups where the REST API or the
Authorization header is blocked.

How it works

  1. Open RankBloom in your WordPress menu and click Connect.
  2. Sign in to RankBloom — or create an account — and approve the connection.
  3. You land back in WordPress, connected. Nothing to copy or paste.
  4. New posts appear automatically.

If the site you are connecting from is not in your RankBloom workspace yet, the connect screen
offers to add it for you and starts analysing it, so you do not have to set it up separately.

Posts are matched by their RankBloom ID, so a post is never imported twice — even if a check is
interrupted and retried.

Official plugin

This is the official RankBloom plugin. RankBloom (getrankbloom.com) is a service built and
operated by Lumora (lumorabuild.com), the author of this plugin — it is not a third-party
integration with somebody else’s product.

External service

The plugin is a client for the RankBloom service. The plugin itself is free; a RankBloom account
is required for it to do anything, because the content it imports is generated and stored on the
service.

The plugin communicates only with https://app.getrankbloom.com, and only once you have connected
your site. It sends:

  • your connection token, to authenticate the request;
  • the result of each import (success or failure, the resulting post URL and ID), so RankBloom
    knows the post is live and stops offering it again;
  • during the one-time connect step only: the address of this site, so RankBloom can match it to
    your workspace (and offer to add it if it is new).

It receives the posts your own workspace generated. No visitor data, no personal data, and no
site content other than the import results listed above is ever transmitted.

  • Service: https://www.getrankbloom.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://www.getrankbloom.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.getrankbloom.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the get-rankbloom folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP through
    Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open RankBloom in your admin menu and click Connect to RankBloom.
  4. Sign in (or sign up), pick the site, approve — you are returned here connected.
sections.faq:
Do I need a RankBloom account?

Yes. The plugin imports content generated by the RankBloom service; without an account there is
nothing to import.

Will it import my whole archive when I connect?

No. A new connection only receives posts created after it was made, so connecting a site with
hundreds of existing posts will not flood your blog. If you do want the older content, use the
“Import older posts” button.

Can it publish without me reviewing first?

Only if you choose that. The default is to import everything as a draft.

Will it create duplicates?

No. Every imported post records its RankBloom ID, and that ID is checked before anything is
created. A retried or interrupted sync will skip posts that already exist — including ones you
have moved to the trash.

What happens if I deactivate it?

Nothing is deleted. Your imported posts, media and settings stay exactly as they are. Uninstalling
removes the plugin’s own settings but never touches your posts.

Does it work if my host blocks the REST API?

Yes. The plugin never accepts inbound requests. It only makes outbound calls to RankBloom, so a
blocked REST API, a firewall, or a stripped Authorization header does not affect it.

Do I have to paste an API key?

No. You click Connect, sign in to RankBloom, and approve. The credential is exchanged behind the
scenes and never shown to you or placed in a URL.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • Changed: documentation now states clearly that this is the official plugin for RankBloom, a
    service operated by the plugin author, rather than a third-party integration.

1.3.0

  • Added: narrated posts now show a “Listen to this article” player, with AudioObject structured
    data so search engines know the article has a spoken version. Can be turned off in Settings.

1.2.0

  • Changed: the plugin is now named “Get RankBloom”, matching the getrankbloom.com service it
    connects to. The text domain moved to get-rankbloom to match the new slug.

1.1.2

  • Fixed: normalised line endings across all plugin files.

1.1.1

  • Changed: each admin action now verifies its security nonce inline, so the check is visible to
    automated review tooling as well as to a human reader.
  • Changed: declared compatibility with WordPress 7.0.

1.1.0

  • Added: “More from Lumora” tab listing the other Lumora Build products.
  • Added: the connect screen now recognises the site you are connecting from, and offers to add it
    to your workspace (and start analysing it) if it is not there yet.
  • Added: a welcome panel and direct links into your workspace after connecting.
  • Fixed: the connect link carried HTML-encoded ampersands, so the security check on the way back
    never matched and the connection could not complete.
  • Fixed: the per-site author byline was missing from imported posts.

1.0.0

  • First release: one-click connect (no API keys), scheduled import of RankBloom posts, featured
    image sideloading, categories and tags, meta description (including Yoast and Rank Math), schema
    markup, audio narration URL, duplicate-safe imports, and manual sync.
